title: The Subsidiary Superpower-How Britain Lost Its Crown to America - Whatfinger News Quick Hits
text:
“Permit me to issue and control the money of a nation, and I care not who makes its laws.” — attributed to Mayer Amschel Rothschild
There is a narrative circulating today—let us call it the Promethean narrative—that offers a seductive explanation for global chaos. It tells its followers that the world is run by a shadowy financial cabal centered in the City of London. It offers an array of verifiable facts: historical coups, real documents, actual names, and secret networks spanning centuries. The followers of this story believe they have named the “real” enemy.
Read Full Article: https://www.lewrockwell.com/2026/08/no_author/the-subsidiary-superpower-how-britain-lost-its-crown-to-america/
